### Setup from setup.R/renv.lock
```{r}
source(here::here("setup.R"))
```

### Download BRFSS
```{r}
download_brfss(2024)
```

### Read BRFSS
```{r}
ingest_brfss_to_duckdb(2024)
```
### Establish Connection to duckDB
```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(shared_home = FALSE),
  dbdir = here::here("data", "brfss.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)

DBI::dbListTables(con)
```

### Exploratory
```{r}
brfss <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
    -- -----------------------
    -- Survey / time
    -- -----------------------
    SEQNO,
    _STATE,
    FMONTH,
    IDATE,
    IMONTH,
    IDAY,
    IYEAR,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Demographics
    -- -----------------------
    SEXVAR,
    _AGEG5YR,
    _AGE65YR,
    _AGE80,
    _RACE,
    _RACEGR3,
    INCOME3,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Healthcare access
    -- -----------------------
    PRIMINS2,
    _HLTHPL2,
    PERSDOC3,
    MEDCOST1,
    CHECKUP1,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Mental / physical health
    -- -----------------------
    GENHLTH,
    PHYSHLTH,
    _PHYS14D,
    MENTHLTH,
    _MENT14D,
    ADDEPEV3,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Social / behavioral context
    -- -----------------------
    EMTSUPRT,
    EXERANY2,
    _TOTINDA,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Survey weighting vars
    -- Keep even if not used yet
    -- -----------------------
    _PSU,
    _STSTR,
    _LLCPWT

  FROM brfss_2024
  "
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()


# Close DuckDB connection
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

## Light QA
```{r}
# First validate that only documented codes are present
stopifnot(
  all(na.omit(unique(brfss$`_MENT14D`)) %in% c(1, 2, 3, 9)),
  all(na.omit(unique(brfss$MEDCOST1)) %in% c(1, 2, 7, 9)),
  all(na.omit(unique(brfss$PERSDOC3)) %in% c(1, 2, 3, 7, 9)),
  all(na.omit(unique(brfss$`_HLTHPL2`)) %in% c(1, 2, 9)),
  all(na.omit(unique(brfss$CHECKUP1)) %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9)),
  all(na.omit(unique(brfss$ADDEPEV3)) %in% c(1, 2, 7, 9))
)

analysis_df <- brfss |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    # Mental health burden
    mh_burden = dplyr::case_when(
      `_MENT14D` == 1 ~ "0 days",
      `_MENT14D` == 2 ~ "1–13 days",
      `_MENT14D` == 3 ~ "14+ days",
      `_MENT14D` == 9 ~ NA_character_,
      is.na(`_MENT14D`) ~ NA_character_
    ),

    mh_burden = factor(
      mh_burden,
      levels = c("0 days", "1–13 days", "14+ days"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    # Needed doctor but could not afford care
    cost_barrier = dplyr::case_when(
      MEDCOST1 == 1 ~ TRUE,
      MEDCOST1 == 2 ~ FALSE,
      MEDCOST1 %in% c(7, 9) ~ NA,
      is.na(MEDCOST1) ~ NA
    ),

    # Does not have a personal healthcare provider
    no_provider = dplyr::case_when(
      PERSDOC3 %in% c(1, 2) ~ FALSE,
      PERSDOC3 == 3 ~ TRUE,
      PERSDOC3 %in% c(7, 9) ~ NA,
      is.na(PERSDOC3) ~ NA
    ),

    # Does not have health insurance
    uninsured = dplyr::case_when(
      `_HLTHPL2` == 1 ~ FALSE,
      `_HLTHPL2` == 2 ~ TRUE,
      `_HLTHPL2` == 9 ~ NA,
      is.na(`_HLTHPL2`) ~ NA
    ),

    # Routine doctor checkup within the past year
    recent_checkup = dplyr::case_when(
      CHECKUP1 == 1 ~ TRUE,
      CHECKUP1 %in% c(2, 3, 4, 8) ~ FALSE,
      CHECKUP1 %in% c(7, 9) ~ NA,
      is.na(CHECKUP1) ~ NA
    ),

    # Ever told respondent had a depressive disorder
    prior_depression = dplyr::case_when(
      ADDEPEV3 == 1 ~ TRUE,
      ADDEPEV3 == 2 ~ FALSE,
      ADDEPEV3 %in% c(7, 9) ~ NA,
      is.na(ADDEPEV3) ~ NA
    )
  )

```

## Check Recodes - sanity check against codebook
```{r}
recode_checks <- list(

  mental_health = analysis_df |>
    count(`_MENT14D`, mh_burden, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
    ),

  cost_barrier = analysis_df |>
    count(MEDCOST1, cost_barrier, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
    ),

  provider = analysis_df |>
    count(PERSDOC3, no_provider, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
    ),

  insurance = analysis_df |>
    count(`_HLTHPL2`, uninsured, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
    ),

  checkup = analysis_df |>
    count(CHECKUP1, recent_checkup, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
    ),

  depression_history = analysis_df |>
    count(ADDEPEV3, prior_depression, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
    )
)

recode_checks
```

# Analysis
## Access to care barriers and mental health burden

```{r}
barrier_missingness <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!is.na(mh_burden)) |>
  select(
    mh_burden,
    cost_barrier,
    no_provider,
    uninsured
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cost_barrier, no_provider, uninsured),
    names_to = "barrier",
    values_to = "has_barrier"
  ) |>
  group_by(mh_burden, barrier) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(has_barrier)),
    pct_missing = mean(is.na(has_barrier)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    barrier = recode(
      barrier,
      cost_barrier = "Could not afford needed care",
      no_provider = "No personal provider",
      uninsured = "Uninsured"
    )
  )

barrier_missingness |>
  mutate(
    pct_missing = scales::percent(pct_missing, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) |>
  arrange(barrier, mh_burden)
```


```{r}
barrier_summary <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!is.na(mh_burden)) |>
  select(
    mh_burden,
    cost_barrier,
    no_provider,
    uninsured
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cost_barrier, no_provider, uninsured),
    names_to = "barrier",
    values_to = "has_barrier"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(has_barrier)) |>
  group_by(mh_burden, barrier) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_barrier = sum(has_barrier),
    pct_barrier = mean(has_barrier),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    barrier = recode(
      barrier,
      cost_barrier = "Could not afford needed care",
      no_provider = "No personal provider",
      uninsured = "Uninsured"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
barrier_summary |>
  select(mh_burden, barrier, pct_barrier) |>
  mutate(
    pct_barrier = round(100 * pct_barrier, 1)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = mh_burden,
    values_from = pct_barrier
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gap_14plus_vs_0 = `14+ days` - `0 days`
  )
```


```{r}
cost_by_insurance <- analysis_df |>
  filter(
    !is.na(mh_burden),
    !is.na(uninsured),
    !is.na(cost_barrier)
  ) |>
  group_by(mh_burden, uninsured) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_cost_barrier = sum(cost_barrier),
    pct_cost_barrier = mean(cost_barrier),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    insurance_status = if_else(
      uninsured,
      "Uninsured",
      "Insured"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    mh_burden,
    insurance_status,
    n,
    n_cost_barrier,
    pct_cost_barrier
  )

cost_by_insurance
```

```{r}
# Define a high healthcare-connection cohort
analysis_df <- analysis_df |>
  mutate(
    well_connected = case_when(
      is.na(uninsured) |
        is.na(no_provider) |
        is.na(recent_checkup) ~ NA,

      uninsured == FALSE &
        no_provider == FALSE &
        recent_checkup == TRUE ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
analysis_df |>
  count(
    uninsured,
    no_provider,
    recent_checkup,
    well_connected,
    .drop = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_total = scales::percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)
  )
```

```{r}
mh_by_connection <- analysis_df |>
  filter(
    !is.na(well_connected),
    !is.na(mh_burden)
  ) |>
  group_by(well_connected, mh_burden) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(well_connected) |>
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    connection_status = if_else(
      well_connected,
      "Well connected",
      "Not well connected"
    )
  )

mh_by_connection
```

## Visualize
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Finding plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------


# Output directory
plot_dir <- here::here("outputs", "figures", "2024")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Slide palette
PURPLE      <- "#4B46FF"
NAVY        <- "#242536"
DARK        <- "#151829"
LAVENDER    <- "#E8E7FF"
LAVENDER_2  <- "#D9D8FF"
GRAY        <- "#D7D6CF"
BG          <- "#F7F6F2"

theme_slide <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = BG, color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = BG, color = NA),

      plot.title = element_text(
        color = DARK,
        face = "bold",
        size = 20,
        margin = margin(b = 6)
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        color = NAVY,
        size = 12.5,
        margin = margin(b = 16)
      ),

      plot.caption = element_text(
        color = "#6C6D78",
        size = 9.5,
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(t = 12)
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        color = NAVY,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.text = element_text(
        color = NAVY
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(color = NAVY),
      legend.position = "top",

      plot.margin = margin(18, 24, 18, 18)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Finding 1
# Higher Mental Health Burden Associated with Barriers in Access to Care
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Total respondents with valid mental-health burden
valid_mh_n <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!is.na(mh_burden)) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  pull(n)

# Valid denominator for each barrier
barrier_n <- barrier_summary |>
  group_by(barrier) |>
  summarise(
    valid_n = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plotting data
barrier_plot_df <- barrier_summary |>
  left_join(
    barrier_n,
    by = "barrier"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Reverse factor order so plot reads low -> high burden from top to bottom
    mh_burden = factor(
      mh_burden,
      levels = c("14+ days", "1–13 days", "0 days"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    barrier = factor(
      barrier,
      levels = c(
        "Could not afford needed care",
        "No personal provider",
        "Uninsured"
      )
    ),

    pct_label = scales::percent(
      pct_barrier,
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),

    label_color = if_else(
      pct_barrier >= 0.17,
      "white",
      NAVY
    )
  )

# Barrier labels with valid denominator
barrier_labels <- barrier_n |>
  mutate(
    barrier = factor(
      barrier,
      levels = c(
        "Could not afford needed care",
        "No personal provider",
        "Uninsured"
      )
    ),

    axis_label = paste0(
      barrier,
      "\n",
      "n = ",
      scales::comma(valid_n)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(barrier)

barrier_label_values <- setNames(
  barrier_labels$axis_label,
  as.character(barrier_labels$barrier)
)

# Plot
p1 <- ggplot(
  barrier_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = barrier,
    y = mh_burden,
    fill = pct_barrier
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    width = 0.94,
    height = 0.84,
    color = BG,
    linewidth = 2.5
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = pct_label,
      color = label_color
    ),
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_color_identity() +

  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = LAVENDER,
    high = PURPLE,
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = barrier_label_values,
    position = "top"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Mental Health Burden and Barriers in Access to Care",

    subtitle = paste0(
      "Cost-related unmet need shows the steepest gradient",
      "\n",
      "Mental-health burden available for N = ",
      scales::comma(valid_mh_n),
      " respondents"
    ),

    x = NULL,
    y = "Poor mental-health days in past 30 days",

    caption = paste0(
      "Source: CDC BRFSS 2024. Unweighted respondent estimates. ",""
    )
  ) +

  theme_slide() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = DARK,
      face = "bold",
      size = 22,
      lineheight = 1.05,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x.top = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10.5,
      lineheight = 1.05,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 12)
    ),

    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "01_mh_burden_access_barriers.png"
  ),
  plot = p1,
  width = 10,
  height = 5.625,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = BG
)

p1
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Finding 2
# Insurance, mental-health burden, and cost barriers
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Total valid denominator by insurance status
insurance_n <- cost_by_insurance |>
  group_by(insurance_status) |>
  summarise(
    valid_n = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create legend labels with denominator
insurance_labels <- insurance_n |>
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste0(
      insurance_status,
      " (n = ",
      scales::comma(valid_n),
      ")"
    )
  )

insurance_label_values <- setNames(
  insurance_labels$legend_label,
  insurance_labels$insurance_status
)

# Plotting data
cost_plot_df <- cost_by_insurance |>
  mutate(
    mh_burden = factor(
      mh_burden,
      levels = c("0 days", "1–13 days", "14+ days"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    insurance_status = factor(
      insurance_status,
      levels = c("Insured", "Uninsured")
    ),

    pct_label = scales::percent(
      pct_cost_barrier,
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  )

# Plot
p2 <- ggplot(
  cost_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = mh_burden,
    y = pct_cost_barrier,
    fill = insurance_status
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    width = 0.62
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct_label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    vjust = -0.45,
    color = NAVY,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Insured" = PURPLE,
      "Uninsured" = NAVY
    ),
    labels = insurance_label_values
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 0.76),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.7, 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Insurance, Mental Health Burden, and Cost Barriers",

    subtitle = paste0(
      "Insurance reduces the cost barrier, but ",
      "higher mental health burden is still associated \nwith higher likelihood of not being able to afford care"
    ),

    x = "Poor mental-health days in past 30 days",
    y = "Could not afford needed care",

    caption = paste0(
      "Analysis includes respondents with valid mental-health burden, ",
      "insurance status, and cost-barrier responses."
    )
  ) +

  theme_slide() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = DARK,
      face = "bold",
      size = 22,
      lineheight = 1.05,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = GRAY,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11.5
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10.5
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),

    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left"
  )

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "02_cost_barrier_by_insurance.png"
  ),
  plot = p2,
  width = 10,
  height = 5.625,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = BG
)
```
